name: confirmation
title: Confirmation
description: The agent asks before it acts: an urgent alert with the question, what will happen, and Deny then Allow (held to confirm when it can't be undone). Once answered it recedes to a quiet record of what was decided, kept in the thread.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/confirmation.md. SwiftUI: MetalConfirmation in the MetalUI Swift package.
